name: Nimbus
description: Nimbus is a self-hosted, multi-user dashboard for your homelab. It checks whether your services are online, shows widgets next to them and puts live numbers from your apps on their tiles.
short_desc: Homelab dashboard with health checks, widgets and app integrations
author: Turbootzz

form_fields.label: Public URL
form_fields.hint: The address you open Nimbus at, for example https://nimbus.example.com. Used in password reset emails and OAuth redirects.
